overview.story:
The Shura clan have thrived in isolation for countless generations, in the Arcapada universe. Their men, renowned for being the world's bravest fighters, and their women famed for being the world's greatest beauties. At the heart of the Shura clan's beliefs lies the legend of the Three Thousand Worlds. The legends speaks of three thousand secret worlds, which upon entering, one must face various levels of psychic and physical trials and advance to world after world upon victory. The people of the Shura clan had discovered a way to enter these worlds, and only those who have conquered over three hundred worlds could be granted the title of Asura, raising them to the level of a demigod in the eyes of their people. However, in the innumerable eons of Shura history, none managed to conquer the fabled three thousand world, until Martis appeared.

With ambition and determination capable of shaking the very heavens, Martis trained every day of his life to become stronger, tirelessly advancing through the secret worlds, each personal breakthrough against the legions of demons granting him a sense of unique personal satisfaction. No one knew how many years passed before Martis reached the final and most hard core secret world. However, his desire for glory drove him onward. After numerous defeats, he fell into despair, but even then, he refused to give up. He transformed his sheer thirst for victory into his twin blades of righteous fury, now known as the Asura's Teeth, and for countless days and nights, battled against the demons of the final world with strength and determination that had never been seen before on the mortal plane. He finally became the first Asura to defeat the three thousand secret worlds and has ever since been regarded as the 'Asura King', ruling, more than tens of milions of aspiring Asura.

abilities.name: Asura's Wrath
abilities.description: Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4s. He gains (+8*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.

abilities.name: Asura Aura
abilities.description: Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals 350/410/470/530/590/650<scaleAD> (+130% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, slowing them by 40% for 2s.

abilities.name: Mortal Coil
abilities.description:
Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225/240/255/270/285/300 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick.

Use Again: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne.
Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

abilities.name: Decimation
abilities.description:
Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700/900/1100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%).
If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10s and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5s. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, engage using Martis' 1st Skill to gather enemies and slow them, then use his 2nd Skill to deal damage and knock them airborne, and continue with Basic Attacks. Finish enemies at low HP with his Ultimate, then chain more kills with the Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, initiate with Martis' 1st Skill to gather enemies and slow them, then follow up with his 2nd Skill. Use his 2nd Skill again to stay on the enemy and knock them airborne, and continue attacking with Basic Attacks.

relationships.description: Martis works best with Fighters that initiate teamfights like Alpha and Khaleed who he can follow up to secure a kill and chain more kills with his Ultimate.

Martis counters squishy heroes with no mobility skills, such as Layla and Odette, who have a hard time avoiding his 1st Skill - 2nd Skill combo. Their relatively low HP also makes it easier for Martis to put them into execute range for his Ultimate.
Martis is countered by Fighters with high combat sustainability, such as Thamuz and Fredrinn, because they can survive Martis' burst damage and defeat him in prolonged battles.
